title: MedQA-CS: Objective Structured Clinical Examination (OSCE)-Style Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Clinical Skills

live_model.evidence: "The LLMs includeding the experiments are the GPT series (GPT-3.5-turbo, GPT-4-turbo, GPT-4o)" (Sec. 3 Experimental Settings); Table 3 row GPT-4 = MedStuLLM score 59.89

prompt.location: Appendix C, Tables 8-10 (MedStuLLM and MedExamLLM prompts)
prompt.note: Student prompts and examiner (judge) prompts are printed in full.

claim.metric: MedExamLLM(GPT-4) clinical-skill score, average over 4 sections

notes: Paper dated 2024-10-02, no preview strings, so 'GPT-4-turbo' resolves to gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 (alias rule). Table rows label the model 'GPT-4'. Subject runs used temperature=0.9 (RQ2), judge runs temperature=0. Judge is the same live model (MedExamLLM = GPT-4-turbo); 1,667 subject calls + 1,667 judge calls per seed, long case contexts.
